We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, technical expertise, and dedication to staying at the forefront of web development best practices. BX Studio was recognized as Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year 2025.


Job description

As a Web Designer at BX Studio, you will play a crucial role in leading the design and development of visually compelling and user-friendly websites for our clients. You will work closely with our clients, project managers, and development team to conceptualize, design, and implement custom web solutions that meet our clients' objectives and exceed their expectations. This role requires comfort using AI-assisted design workflows to support faster ideation, stronger creative exploration, improved UX thinking, and efficient delivery across modern website projects.


Key Responsibilities


● Lead the design process from concept to completion, ensuring all deliverables meet  high-quality standards and align with client goals.


● Collaborate with clients to understand their brand identity, target audience, and business objectives in order to create customized website designs that resonate with their audience.


● Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and user interactions to support rapid exploration and iteration.


● Create visually appealing graphics, icons, and other assets to enhance the overall aesthetic and user experience of websites, to meet BX Studio’s standards for originality, quality, and brand fit.


● Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, emerging technologies, and AI-assisted design workflows to continually improve the quality and innovation of our web designs.


● Mentor and provide guidance to junior designers, fostering their growth and development within the team.

● Work closely with the development team to ensure seamless integration of design elements and functionality.


● Conduct usability testing and gather feedback to iterate and refine designs for optimal user experience to identify patterns, summarize feedback, and support design improvements.


● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project timelines and milestones are met effectively to improve speed, quality, and delivery efficiency.


Qualifications:


● Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or a related field.


● Minimum of 5 years of experience in web design, with a strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful projects.


● Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD), Sketch, or Figma, with practical experience using AI-assisted design tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Figma AI, Relume, Framer AI, or similar tools.


● Solid understanding of responsive design principles and best practices for web usability and accessibility, content hierarchy, and UX improvements.


● Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/jQuery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with developers on both traditional and AI-enabled website experiences.


● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present and explain design concepts to clients and team members.


● Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines to improve efficiency without compromising quality.


● Experience with content management systems (CMS) such as Webflow, with familiarity in Webflow, and Framer is considered a strong plus.


● A passion for creativity, innovation, and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and responsible AI use in modern web design.


Join our dynamic team and help us create exceptional web experiences that drive success for our clients! If you're passionate about design, technology, AI-assisted workflows, and making a real impact, we want to hear from you.

title: Sr AI Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr AI Engineer - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer


PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO

A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop.

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

• Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

• Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

• Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

• Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

• Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

• AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.


Job Description


The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”

• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.

• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams

  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click

title: Engenheiro de IA Generativa - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Generativa - Especialista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:


• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

• Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

• Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.

• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

• Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.

Perfil esperado:


• Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

• Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.

• Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.

• Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.

• Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

• Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.

• Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.

• Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.

• Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.

• Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.

• Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.

title: Médico Pediatra (RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Pediatra (RQE) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!


O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.


  • Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.


  • Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.


Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: BI Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para BI Operations Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Account Manager
description:

title: Data Scientist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Analyst/ Data Scientist

Experience

Minimum 5 years


Engagement Type

Short Term Contract ( 3 months)


Skill

  • 3+ years data analytics or data science
  • Strong SQL (complex queries, CTEs, window functions) and understanding of dimensional modeling (fact/dim tables)
  • Experience with product event data (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel patterns)
  • BigQuery experience and Familiar with data quality challenges and how to handle them

Availability

8 hours per day with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.



Role Overview

We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst/ Data Scientist who is strong in SQL and understands how product data works, who has built schemas, debugged data quality issues, and explained to someone why two dashboards show different numbers for the same metric.

What does day-to-day life look like?

You will define the data infrastructure behind these product teams - what tables exist, what events fire, what breaks. Think of it as designing the realistic data environment an analyst would actually query. We are building an AI benchmark and need realistic data artifacts - BigQuery schemas, SQL queries, event taxonomies, metric definitions. You will write and review these, making sure they are technically accurate and include the kind of data quality issues you would see in real systems.


Requirements


  • 5+ years data analytics or data science
  • Strong SQL (complex queries, CTEs, window functions) and understanding of dimensional modeling (fact/dim tables)
  • Experience with product event data (Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel patterns)
  • BigQuery experience and Familiar with data quality challenges and how to handle them


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 6 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India/ LATAM

title: Engenheiro de Confiabilidade de Sites (SRE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Confiabilidade de Sites (SRE) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento varejista de materiais de construção e melhoria residencial..


Key Responsibilities

  • Buscamos um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) com forte atuação em ambientes Kubernetes
  • Responsável por garantir a estabilidade, confiabilidade e observabilidade dos sistemas
  • Atuação hands-on em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas
  • Realização de ajustes em infraestrutura
  • Suporte a aplicações, incluindo:
  • Leitura de código em Go
  • Realização de pequenos patches


Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • Experiência prática como SRE, DevOps ou função similar
  • Domínio de Kubernetes (deployments, debugging e operação)
  • Experiência com:
  • Helm

  • Conhecimento em Envoy (troubleshooting e debugging)
  • Capacidade de ler e fazer pequenos patches em código Go

  • Boa capacidade de troubleshooting em ambientes distribuídos

title: Engenheiro de IA Generativa - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Generativa - Especialista em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:


• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

• Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

• Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.

• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

• Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.

Perfil esperado:


• Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

• Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.

• Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.

• Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.

• Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

• Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.

• Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.

• Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.

• Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.

• Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.

• Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.

title: CFP Automation Specialist
description:

The ideal candidate will support our advisory team by improving internal workflows and leveraging technology to automate routine tasks within our wealth‑management operations.


This role is ideal for someone who can blend financial-planning expertise with systems thinking, helping us scale efficiently while maintaining a high‑touch client experience.


Key Responsibilities

Process Automation & Systems Optimization

  • Identify recurring tasks and workflows that can be automated within CRM, custodian platforms, and planning tools.
  • Build or enhance automation using RIA technology such as:
  • Practifi (e.g., Salesforce, Practifi)
  • Workflow tools (Jump, Zapier, Co-Pilot)
  • Planning software integrations
  • Portfolio management systems
  • Custodian Platforms (Charles Schwab, Fidelity, TIAA-CREF)

Collaboration & Communication

  • Provide clear written updates and status tracking on workflow progress.

Required

  • Strong understanding of investment products, retirement planning, advanced financial planning tools, and wealth‑management essentials.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred

  • Experience working with U.S.-based RIAs.
  • Familiarity with custodians such as Schwab, Fidelity, or TIAA-CREF.
  • Understanding of RIA compliance workflows and documentation standards.
  • Exposure to portfolio management tools (Orion, Advyzon).

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?



About you:

This is a direct-hire, high-impact position designed for a support professional who views every interaction as an opportunity to build a relationship. As a Customer Support Specialist, you are the primary face and voice of Smarter Contact across our multiple support channels.


Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. You are not just closing tickets, you are solving complex SMS delivery issues, guiding customers through compliance requirements, and ensuring every interaction is handled with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.


As a frontline representative of the company, you are uniquely positioned to identify customer needs and opportunities to improve retention and account growth. You will help surface opportunities for plan upgrades and add-ons while serving as a first line of defence against churn by identifying customer friction early, escalating issues appropriately, and partnering closely with Success and Product teams to help customers stay successful and engaged.



What You’ll Own:

  • Provide high-quality assistance through real-time chat, emails and phone calls, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels.
  • Consistently maintain a CSAT score of over 85% while meeting targets for response times and resolution speed.
  • Achieve monthly revenue quotas by identifying and closing plan upgrades during customer interactions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chats, calls, and tasks within the CRM to ensure team-wide visibility.
  • Identify early warning signs like frustration or delivery issues during live chats and resolve them to protect account health.
  • Reinforce the Smarter Contact value proposition and competitive edge in every customer conversation.
  • Capture and relay frontline insights regarding bugs, UX friction, and feature requests to the Product and Leadership teams.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 8 AM - 8 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Growth Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Growth Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Localização

Remoto


Tipo de Contrato

Prestação de Serviços (PJ)


Sobre a vaga

Procuramos Project Manager pra coordenar a execução das contas de growth da agência. A pessoa é o motor que transforma estratégia em entrega: traduz decisão em brief, distribui pra especialistas (conteúdo, criação, dev, mídia paga, etc), garante prazo, antecipa bloqueio e mantém o cliente com a sensação de que tudo está rodando.

Não é função de atendimento estratégico. Estratégia é definida pelo especialista em growth. Você é quem garante que ela vira realidade no prazo certo, com qualidade.

Atendemos clientes B2B no Brasil e nos Estados Unidos, então parte da operação acontece em inglês. 

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Traduzir decisões estratégicas (vindas de call ou clip gravado no ClickUp) em briefs claros pros especialistas
  • Coordenar sprints quinzenais de cada cliente, do planning à entrega
  • Cobrar prazo e qualidade dos especialistas internos sem virar atrito
  • Manter o ClickUp como fonte única de verdade: tasks atualizadas, status correto, prazos visíveis
  • Antecipar bloqueios e escalar pro Growth Lead antes de virar problema com cliente
  • Participar de reuniões internas e produzir artefatos (atas com decisões e planos de ação)
  • Cuidar de comunicação operacional com cliente (status report, follow-up de aprovação, agendamento) em português e inglês
  • Identificar pontos de fricção no processo da agência e propor melhoria


O que você precisa ter vivido

  • +2 anos coordenando projetos, idealmente em agência, consultoria ou ops de startup
  • Inglês fluente, escrito e falado. Você vai conduzir reuniões, escrever status reports e trocar mensagens com clientes nos EUA
  • Comunicação escrita clara e objetiva em português e inglês (vamos pedir exemplo nos dois idiomas no processo seletivo)
  • Domínio de ClickUp. Operamos 100% no ClickUp, então fluência aqui acelera muito a entrada
  • Capacidade de cobrar prazo de pessoa mais sênior tecnicamente sem perder a mão
  • Organização obsessiva: você é a pessoa que nunca esquece follow-up


Diferencial, mas não obrigatório

  • Experiência prévia em agência de marketing ou growth
  • Vivência atendendo cliente internacional, especialmente nos EUA
  • Familiaridade com vocabulário de growth B2B (funil, ABM, mídia paga, lifecycle)
  • Vivência em automatização de processo (Zapier e agentes do ClickUp)


O que não esperamos

Não precisa ter experiência executando campanha, escrevendo copy ou desenhando estratégia. Esse não é o papel. Se você gosta mais de operar do que criar conteúdo de growth, é pra você.


Como vamos medir seu trabalho

  • Entregas saindo no prazo combinado em cada sprint
  • Tempo do Growth Lead liberado pra estratégia (você cuida da execução)
  • Adoção e consistência dos processos da agência no ClickUp
  • Saúde das contas que você coordena (sem cliente surpreso com atraso)


Contexto importante

Estamos em transição para um novo modelo de agência. Boa parte do processo de operação está sendo desenhada agora, e quem entrar nesse momento influencia como a agência vai funcionar daqui pra frente. Se você curte ambiente em construção e quer deixar marca no processo, vai gostar. Se prefere chegar em estrutura totalmente pronta, esse provavelmente não é o melhor momento.

Se você se reconheceu na descrição e quer construir esse processo junto, candidate-se aqui:

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Salesforce Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Required Skills & Experience


  • 5–7+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer
  • Salesforce development experience, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, Flows, Lightning Applications, SOQL, SOSL, Aura Framework
  • Experience with Salesforce custom objects, validation rules, workflows, reports, dashboards, and analytic snapshots
  • Salesforce technical experience, including Apex classes, controllers, triggers, web services, and SFDX command line
  • Ability to perform Salesforce admin functions as needed
  • Strong AWS development experience
  • AWS technical skills, including Node.js, Lambda, SNS, SQS, API Gateway, IAM roles and policies, Secrets Manager, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, Route 53
  • Experience with REST APIs, command line tools, build and deployment processes, and application security
  • AWS architectural knowledge, including regions, availability zones, CloudWatch, X-Ray, and CloudTrail
  • Experience deploying with CloudFormation, SAM build, and deploy
  • Ability to support large systems with multiple concurrent projects
  • Highly hands-on, fast learner, and comfortable owning enhancements and performance-related work immediately


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


  • Healthcare industry experience
  • React.js, Amplify, Groovy
  • EventBridge exposure
  • Experience supporting mobile application integrations
  • Background in highly customized, homegrown enterprise systems


Job Description


Insight Global is seeking a Senior Salesforce & AWS Developer to join a highly technical, hands-on development team supporting large-scale, custom-built applications. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and supporting Salesforce applications integrated with AWS-based data processing and distribution systems.

The environment consists primarily of homegrown applications, where Salesforce serves as the system of record and AWS is used to extract, transform, and distribute data to multiple downstream systems, state agencies, and mobile applications. This team is separate from Salesforce administration and is fully focused on development through code. The developer must be comfortable contributing on day one and working across all areas of the application ecosystem.


Pay ranges from 25-30 USD/hr based on qualifications and years of experience

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring: Executive Assistant — Home Services (Remote, Brazil)

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to be the right hand of a business owner running a fast-growing home services operation in the U.S. market. You'll work directly with the owner — closing deals, running daily operations, and keeping the business moving. If you've sold before and have the numbers to prove it, keep reading.


Compensation — $1,000 to $1,800/month (USD)


Your base is $1,000/month. Your performance moves it up — permanently.

  • $1,000/month base (USD)
  • +$250 permanent raise after closing $5K in revenue
  • +$150 permanent raise after closing $10K in revenue
  • + performance incentives based on deals closed, profit margins, and reviews generated


Hit your numbers and you ramp from $1,000 to $1,800/month. The ceiling moves with you — there's no cap on what a real closer can earn here.


What You'll Do


Sales (core of the role):

  • Handle inbound leads
  • Run outbound outreach (calls, follow-ups, cold calling)
  • Qualify and close high-ticket services ($1K–$5K+)
  • Own and manage the pipeline


Daily Operations:

  • Dispatch service providers and coordinate jobs
  • Collect payment from customers
  • Follow up post-service to make sure customers are satisfied
  • Handle admin tied to the owner's day-to-day


Hiring (when needed):

  • Run end-to-end hiring — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding new team members


Requirements

  • Based in Brazil, working remotely
  • Proven sales background with results you can speak to (mandatory)
  • Strong English — C1 or higher
  • Excellent, reliable internet (non-negotiable)
  • Comfortable working across U.S. time zones
  • Able to run full-cycle sales, not just closing


One Thing to Be Clear About

This is a performance role for people who want to win. You'll be the owner's right hand — sales is the core of the job, but you'll also be the person they trust to keep operations running and the team growing. If you don't have real sales experience and real results, this isn't the seat for you. If you do — this is the kind of role that changes your trajectory.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

• Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

• Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

• Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

• Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

• Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

• AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.


Job Description


The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”

• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.

• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Executivo(a) Comercial | Feira de Santana - Bahia | Liora Energia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) Comercial | Feira de Santana - Bahia | Liora Energia em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.


A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.


Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui


Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Como Executivo(a) Comercial, você será a cara da Liora para nossos clientes, sendo peça-chave para estruturar e escalar nossos canais de vendas. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.


Você será a peça-chave para:

  • Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
  • Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
  • Construir relações de confiança que duram.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.
  • Desenvolver Parcerias Estratégicas: Mapear, negociar e ativar redes de parceiros que nos ajudem a multiplicar nosso alcance e impacto.
  • Realizar Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes para apresentar a solução da Liora de forma personalizada e irresistível.
  • Conduzir o Ciclo de Vendas Completo: Apresentar propostas de valor, negociar com clareza e fechar contratos que gerem valor real para os clientes e para a Liora.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente: Trazer feedbacks valiosos do mercado para colaborar com os times de Produto, Marketing e Pós-venda, nos ajudando a melhorar continuamente.


O que Buscamos em Você:

  • Perfil Hunter: Você tem energia, resiliência e paixão por abrir novas portas e prospectar clientes.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara, direta e empática, criando conexões genuínas.
  • Foco no Cliente: Uma obsessão por entender, resolver problemas e encantar quem está do outro lado da linha.
  • Mentalidade de Dono(a): Autonomia para planejar, agilidade para executar e flexibilidade para ajustar a rota em busca dos melhores resultados.
  • Ambição Gigante: O desejo de não apenas bater metas, mas de construir a maior e mais confiável provedora de serviços de energia do Brasil


Nossa Proposta de Valor:

  • Remuneração Sem Teto: Salário fixo competitivo + comissionamento agressivo e sem limites. Aqui, seu resultado define seu ganho.
  • Plano de Saúde: Subsidiado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale-Refeição/Alimentação.
  • Vale-Transporte ou Auxílio Deslocamento.


E aí, vamos transformar o futuro da energia juntos?

Se você se identificou com a nossa missão e acredita que tem o perfil para este desafio, queremos te conhecer!


#VemPraLiora #EnergiaSimples #Transformação #VendasComPropósito

title: Sr. TypeScript Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. TypeScript Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Sr. TypeScript Developer to join our innovative and dynamic team.

  • Fluent or very strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross‑functional teams.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

﻿

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.
